item.title: Dell PERC H755 firmware fatal error and controller reset after single SSD failure — Proxmox/Ceph node-wide I/O hang
item.author: invalid@example.com (zabbix5674)
item.dc:creator: zabbix5674
item.content:encoded:
Hi everyone,





We had a strange storage issue on October 13 with a Dell R750 running Proxmox VE 9.2.21 and Ceph 20.2.4. The server uses a PERC H755 Front (firmware 52.21.1-5149) for both its OS RAID1 and Ceph SSDs. One SATA SSD used by OSD.4 started timing out and was marked offline. Shortly after, the PERC logged a fatal firmware error (SnapDumpHelper.c:360) and reset. Linux showed "FW in FAULT state" (0x10000), 166 outstanding I/Os, and system processes blocked for over 122 seconds...
